skills.name: Sword Flute (笛中剑/笛の剣)
skills.line: Flute in my hands, sword in my heart.
skills.description: Mannendake uses his Sword Flute to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK and has a 30% chance of issuing a Call to Arms.

skills.name: Leaf Barrier (竹叶守护/竹の葉の守り)
skills.description:
At the end of Mannendake's turn, he gains Leaf Barrier, lasts 1 turn.
;Leaf Barrier (竹の葉の守り)
